title: Sprint 6 - Partitioning, Materialized Views & Fuzzy Search

tickets.title: Declarative Table Partitioning by Timestamp Range
tickets.description: Creates a declaratively partitioned `transactions` table using timestamp ranges to split transaction rows by year.
tasks: Creates a declaratively partitioned `transactions` table using timestamp ranges to split transaction rows by year.
learning_objectives: Understand relational database design and PostgreSQL features.
tickets.evaluation: `check_table_partitioned("partitioned_transactions")` `verify_partition_exists("tx_2024")` **[A] Correctness (40 pts)**: 40 pts if partition tables map records successfully. **[B] Optimality (30 pts)**: 30 pts for correct range bounds without overlaps. **[C] Quality (20 pts)**: 20 pts for explicit timezone settings on partition ranges.
common_mistakes: Forgetting semicolons at the end of statements.
Using reserved keywords as column names without quotes.
hints: Review the PostgreSQL documentation for exact syntax.
Test your queries in smaller chunks first.

tickets.title: Materialized Views with Auto-Refresh

tasks: Generates a materialized view summarizing monthly branch customer deposit statistics, adding index coverage to fast-track reports.
